name: Panarottis Hartenbos
address: Shop 16, Hartenbos Seefront, Kaap De Goede Hoop Ave, Hartenbos, Mossel Bay, 6520, South Africa
description_short: Family-friendly Italian chain serving pizzas, pastas and breakfast right on the Hartenbos beachfront.
description_long:
Situated on the Hartenbos Seefront, this Panarottis brings reliable Italian favourites to families and holidaymakers looking for easy beachside dining. The menu covers the classics — wood-fired pizzas, generous pasta dishes, and breakfast served throughout the day — making it a practical choice when you're fresh off the sand or planning a casual meal with the kids.

The location puts you steps from the beach, with views over the water and a relaxed vibe that suits Hartenbos perfectly. It's the kind of spot where you can rock up in your takkies after a day at the beach, order a pizza to share, and let the children run around without worry. Takeaway is available if you'd rather enjoy your meal back at your accommodation.
